piTable.statement: internal anchors (offices 1..5): exactly two Hamming-2 A0 neighbors form the unique Hamming-2-adjacent pair on which the containment sandwich holds - that pair is the constructor pair. Boundary anchors (offices 0 and 6): exactly one Hamming-2 neighbor; construction is T+/-1 twin-closure (unique rotation partner), and the sandwich does not hold on the constructor pair. The unrestricted sandwich scan (all 21 A0 pairs) is non-unique by itself; the Hamming-2 adjacency restriction is the identifying condition - recorded as a bounded observation.

synthesis.verdictStatement: The office structure is intrinsically recoverable from mask geometry up to the Lydian/Locrian reflection. The seven A0 offices are the positions of the 7-35 modes on the Hamming-2 line graph (P7), derived from pitch masks alone; the seven A1 offices are the frozen midZ7 midpoints of their constructors' line positions. The global reversal (which terminal is office 0) is not derivable from mask geometry by the midpoint relation: midZ7 is reflection-equivariant (midZ7(6-a,6-b) = (6 - midZ7(a,b)) % 7, verified on all 49 label pairs), so the midpoint law holds identically in both orientations and is reflection-blind; no other mask-only orientation signal was found (the two terminals' D-tier containment profiles are identical). The reversal requires exactly one bit, supplied either by the interpretive brightness premise (max-pcSum endpoint = office 0; framework 7-35 mode-order convention carried as interpretation vocabulary) or by one comparison against the granted office fields (outcome M1: kappa1 matches 7/7, kappa0 1/7). Both routes agree on kappa1.
